Tax Reconciliation

The Tax Reconciliation report helps you verify that your recorded tax liabilities match your actual tax payments.

This report compares the tax amounts calculated on transactions with the tax payments made to tax authorities, helping you identify any discrepancies.

Use this report to ensure your tax records are accurate and complete before filing tax returns or during tax audits.

Description

Add an optional description or note that will appear on the report.

Accounting method

Select whether to use accrual or cash basis accounting for this report.

Periods

Add one or more periods to compare tax reconciliation across different time frames.
